svg.title: L2 default drive registry
svg.desc: Four designer-injected drives ordered by priority: survival, integrity, continuity, curiosity. Each is fed by specific L1 signal types. Registry is extensible.
svg.text: priority order: survival > integrity > continuity > curiosity

g.text: these four are designer-injected and immutable at runtime — not because the designer knows best,
but because emergent drives in capable systems can't be audited. explicit drives can.
registry is extensible: new drives can be added (e.g. "social trust" once L5 exists, "economic
sustainability" once a wallet is connected). but adding one is a deliberate architectural decision.
